verdict.rationale: AMD publishes 288GB HBM3E and 8TB/s bandwidth per GPU, with MXFP4/MXFP6 quantized datatype support. That is ample capacity for a 70B-class quantized model on a single GPU or node. Independent analysis corroborates the capacity and bandwidth lead over B200, and ROCm documents vLLM and SGLang inference recipes. Missing for 10: a documented or hands-on benchmark of a 70B-class quantized model on a single MI355X (the community benchmark cited covers a TP8 multi-GPU setup with an unspecified model)
